summary: Split 4a: uniform UI rect in stretch mode and mouse mapping
author: pm
body:
In stretch mode the world fills the window while the UI keeps a uniform, centred scale. Mouse maps window -> UI units through the UI rect, and world picking maps through the world rect; `TransformMouseCoords` and `update_cursor_clip` share one rect helper.

**Done when:** clicks hit dialogs and world targets correctly in letterbox and stretch; reviewed.

Source: user request 2026-11-23; plan .claude/design/plans/world-screen-split.md.
